items.title: Micron Technology (MU) Keeps DRAM Price Fixing Lawsuit Alive After Judge Rejection
items.summary: Micron Technology (NasdaqGS:MU), Samsung, and SK Hynix failed to convince a U.S. judge to dismiss a DRAM price fixing class action. The ruling keeps alive allegations that the chipmakers coordinated DRAM production cuts and product shifts to support higher prices. The lawsuit covers buyers of DRAM memory chips in the U.S. and claims harm from allegedly inflated prices across multiple years. This refusal to dismiss the alleged DRAM price fixing case is an important factor to weigh alongside...
